title: The Rebbe Explained the Dream That Changed My Life
blurb: In a podcast interview, Reb Shimon Kroll of Pomona, NY, recalls growing up in Brooklyn and being scouted for the major leagues, his path to Lubavitch, and the seven yechidus'n he merited with the Rebbe, including the Rebbe’s interpretation of a dream.

title: The Chossid Who Brought Chassidus to the Public
blurb: 20 Years : 23 Cheshvan marks the yahrtzeit of Reb Tzvi Hirsh Gansbourg , a devoted chossid who worked closely with the Rebbe on publishing Chassidic teachings, led niggunim at the Rebbe's farbrengens, and dedicated his life to spreading Yiddishkeit and helping fellow Yidden.

title: The Hungarian Journalist with a Unique Shlichus from the Rebbe
blurb: 23 Cheshvan marks the yahrtzeit of Reb Chaim Yehuda Paldi , who passed away in 5743 (1982). A former Pressburger Yeshiva talmid, he dedicated his writing abilities to fighting the Mihu Yehudi decree and disputing the claim that the founding of the State of Israel marked the beginning of the Geulah.
